Sam (AM): Quick sync 50k POC with ClearLedger. They require EU-only processing for auditors and want: subprocessors CSV, a short routing config (pinned regions) and a statement on whether any telemetry/metrics leave the EU. Can we assemble a handoff?
Priya (SE): Yes. We can pin to eu-west1 + eu-central1 and set fallback: none so requests fail if capacity exhausted. Need expected qps/tokens to estimate uplift.
Sam (AM): Expect ~40 r/s, avg 180 tokens. No BYOK for POC.
Leo (Legal): I'll compile subprocessors. We must explicitly call out control-plane telemetry location and say no payload/PII leaves EU.
Jon (SRE): Tech note: data plane (inference) stays in pinned regions. Small routing health metadata may be sent to control-plane (us-central). We can document that as anonymized telemetry only. For strict EU-only, enterprise engineering can route control-plane to EU but that's out of scope for quick POC. Cost uplift estimate for pinned routing: ~13% for their profile.
Priya (SE): Sample config to share:
```
routing_policy:
  mode: pin-list
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]
  fallback: none   # fail-closed (429/503)
  cache_scope: regional
```
Priya (SE): Also will include curl example and retry guidance (3 retries, exp backoff).
Leo (Legal): Draft language for auditors: "Inference requests and model execution will occur only in EU pinned regions. Control-plane operational telemetry (routing health, anonymized metrics, request hashes) may be processed outside the EU; no customer payloads or PII will be transmitted." I'll attach subprocessors CSV.
Sam (AM): Deadline: customer wants packet by EOD tomorrow. Can we do that?
Jon (SRE): I can provide network path diagram + cost uplift calc and create a routing ticket.
ticket-bot: PRESALES-9207 created. Owner: Jon (SRE). ETA: 48h.
Sam (AM): Perfect. I'll bundle subproc list (Leo), routing config & runbook (Priya), and cost note (Jon). Will update when signed. :thumbsup:
